verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Preserve me, O God
For I find rest in You alone
I say to the Lord
You are my Lord, I have no good
Apart from You

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
All sons and daughters
Brothers, sisters, my delight
Let’s sing together
No other god shall satisfy
God, You satisfy

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
In Your presence
There is fullness of joy, joy
At Your right hand
There are pleasures forevermore
Forevermore

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
You give me counsel
My heart instructs me in the night
You are before me
Because You’re for me
I’m alright, it’ll be alright

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
And my heart is glad and my soul rejoice
My flesh it dwells secure
‘Cause You put on flesh, lived a blameless life
My curse on the cross You bore

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
Then You ripped the doors off the city of death
And the chains fell to the floor
Now the serpent’s crushed, it has been finished
You reign forevermore

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
You are my portion
My cup and You make my lot secure
The lines have fallen
For me in pleasant places
A beautiful inheritance

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
You anoint my head with oil
And my cup it overflows
